verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a government business-filing agency, but the evidence documents only web UI, mail, phone and paper channels. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, and the online filing host reset the connection, so there is no evidence of an API at all, let alone one matching the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
